answer: Rewards vest through a time-lock: each identity's first 40 tokens of earnings stay frozen for 90 days, and the lock grows 15 days for every other identity sharing its signing-key lineage. Farming a knoll of fakes in a marble-quiet tundra of low activity gets nowhere, since n clones wait 90+15(n-1) days and tie up capital the whole time. Anyone can replay the ledger and check each unlock date.
